Brief for week of 2026-08-24. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx is 4,105 for the week of 2026-08-24.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is down 3.7% against the weeks from 2026-07-13 to 2026-08-17.
BXA held 30.4% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the week-over-week change (down 5.6%), because it compares one week with one week.
Before Metacora launched, BXA held 35.4% of the four-brand basket.
## The numbers
Scope: week of 2026-08-24, compared with the weeks from 2026-07-13 to 2026-08-17.
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,105 a week across 8 of 8 territories, down 3.7% against the comparison weeks.
Week over week, BXA TRx is 4,105 against 4,349 the week before (down 5.6%).
Against the comparison weeks, Southeast fell most (down 17.8%) and Pacific rose most (up 3.7%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-24: projected national. Hollow points are projected or estimated, an assumption (weeks of 2026-07-06). No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,269 in the week of 2026-06-01 to 4,105 in the week of 2026-08-24.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 556 BXA TRx a week; down 12.3% on the week before; down 13.0% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 671 BXA TRx a week; down 2.9% on the week before; up 1.2% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 346 BXA TRx a week; up 8.5% on the week before; down 1.9% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 372 BXA TRx a week; down 4.9% on the week before; up 0.6% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 362 BXA TRx a week; down 13.4% on the week before; down 4.3% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 712 BXA TRx a week; down 1.5% on the week before; up 3.7% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 617 BXA TRx a week; down 1.6% on the week before; up 2.3% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 469 BXA TRx a week; down 14.1% on the week before; down 17.8% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: competitor Metacora (launched 2026-03-02). This is a continuing story, week 25 since launch, still growing. Metacora held 15.9% of the four-brand basket and BXA held 30.4%, against 35.4% for BXA in the four weeks before launch. Confidence: Medium. The share loss is measured; its effect on volume is not separated from other drivers.
Chart: Shares of the four-brand basket, 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-24, every reportable territory.
Metacora held 15.9% of the basket in the week of 2026-08-24.
Considered and dropped: 8 territories moved within their normal range.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 8 of 8 territories pass the feed gate for 2026-08-24. No cut is withheld.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-24. Crossed cells are estimated, an assumption.
1 territory-week in this window is not an observed count.
## Next checks
- Metacora: track the basket shares each week. Owner: marketing and sales. Unlocks: whether to adjust the response to Metacora.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the weeks from 2026-07-13 to 2026-08-17. Source: analyst's choice.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Holiday weeks are left out. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

CMP-3.question: Week of 2026-08-24: What changed this week?

P1-Q1.answer:
Brief for week of 2026-07-06. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Data warning: Great Lakes' feed for 2026-07-06 failed its checks, so its TRx is estimated from its recent share of national, an assumption. No story is given for it.
Projected national BXA TRx is 4,285 for the week of 2026-07-06.
Like for like on 7 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 7.6% against the four weeks before (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-29).
BXA held 32.0% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: Great Lakes' TRx of 620 is an assumption, estimated from its recent share of national, because its feed failed its checks.
Before Metacora launched, BXA held 35.4% of the four-brand basket.
## The numbers
Scope: week of 2026-07-06, compared with the four weeks before (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-29). Levels marked projected or estimated are assumptions.
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 3,665 a week across 7 of 8 territories, up 7.6% against the comparison weeks.
Week over week, BXA TRx is 3,665 against 3,994 the week before (down 8.2%).
On the 7 territories that report both weeks, BXA TRx went from 3,381 to 3,665 (up 8.4%).
Against the comparison weeks, South Central fell most (down 8.4%) and Pacific rose most (up 55.9%).
The headline total of reportable cuts is down 8.0%, but that move comes mostly from withheld cuts, so it is a data artifact, not a business change.
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2026-04-13 to 2026-07-06: projected national. Hollow points are projected or estimated, an assumption (weeks of 2026-05-04, 2026-07-06). No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,653 in the week of 2026-04-13 to 4,285 in the week of 2026-07-06.
By territory, observed unless marked; a projected or estimated level is an assumption, not an observed count.
Great Lakes: 620 BXA TRx a week (estimated, an assumption: its share of national in the four clean weeks before; its feed failed the gate); no change is given, because a week compared failed the feed gate.
Mid-Atlantic: 683 BXA TRx a week; down 4.1% on the week before; up 3.4% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 317 BXA TRx a week; up 13.2% on the week before; down 0.5% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 423 BXA TRx a week; up 41.9% on the week before; up 10.8% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 394 BXA TRx a week; down 4.6% on the week before; up 4.4% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 699 BXA TRx a week; up 44.7% on the week before; up 55.9% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 535 BXA TRx a week; down 6.0% on the week before; down 8.4% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 614 BXA TRx a week; down 1.9% on the week before; down 3.5% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Pacific. BXA TRx averaged 699 a week against 449 before (up 55.9%), while the other territories were flat 0.3%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Pacific cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the Pacific plans in the tested months.
- Promotion: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. Aggregated calls averaged 59 a week against 52 in the reference weeks.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 1.00.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 10.7% of the basket here against 10.3% elsewhere.
Confidence: Low. Unresolved, investigate next. No driver is named.
Chart: Pacific BXA TRx a week, 2026-04-13 to 2026-07-06, against the band of its baseline weeks (406 to 483). No driver was supported, so only TRx is shown.
In the week of 2026-07-06, Pacific had 699 BXA TRx, above its baseline band.
Cuts of the change by plan, weekly TRx. Total: up 251 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan one: up 64 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D plan one: up 42 TRx a week.
- Medicaid plan one: up 39 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
- Medicare Part D plan two: up 30 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan two: up 26 TRx a week.
Cuts of the change by specialty, weekly TRx. Total: up 251 TRx a week.
- Primary care: up 110 TRx a week.
- Internal medicine: up 89 TRx a week.
- Cardiology: up 26 TRx a week.
- Endocrinology: up 26 TRx a week.
Cuts of the change by channel, weekly TRx. Total: up 251 TRx a week.
- Commercial: up 90 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D: up 72 TRx a week.
- Medicaid: up 59 TRx a week.
- Cash: up 30 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
Story two: competitor Metacora (launched 2026-03-02). This is a continuing story, week 18 since launch, still growing. Metacora held 13.1% of the four-brand basket and BXA held 32.0%, against 35.4% for BXA in the four weeks before launch. Confidence: Medium. The share loss is measured; its effect on volume is not separated from other drivers.
Chart: Shares of the four-brand basket, 2026-04-13 to 2026-07-06, every reportable territory.
Metacora held 13.1% of the basket in the week of 2026-07-06.
Data story: national BXA TRx over the reportable territories fell 8.0%, but on the 7 territories that report both periods it rose 7.6%: Great Lakes is withheld. Confidence: High. Leading driver: data.
Considered and dropped: 6 territories moved within their normal range.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 7 of 8 territories pass the feed gate for 2026-07-06. Withheld cuts are left out of every like-for-like figure and story, and never read as zero demand.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2026-04-13 to 2026-07-06. Hollow cells are projected and crossed cells are estimated, both assumptions.
2 territory-weeks in this window are not observed counts.
- Great Lakes, week of 2026-07-06: not reportable (duplicate keys, row counts that do not reconcile, incomplete source); 143 rows against 128 expected, 15 duplicate keys. Raw, before deduplication, Great Lakes BXA TRx sums to 670; with each duplicated key counted once it is 624, so the raw sum overstates it by 46 TRx (7.4%). Do not quote the raw sum.
Great Lakes's observed BXA TRx ranged from 543 to 613 a week in the comparison weeks, which is what its estimated level stands in for.
Great Lakes is estimated from its share of national in the four latest weeks in which every territory passed the gate, because the cut failed for reasons that make its own count unusable (duplicate keys, row counts that do not reconcile, incomplete source).
Assumption: a projected or estimated level is not an observed count, so the projected national rests on it. It is a level only: no story or driver is given for it.
## Next checks
- Pacific: split by plan and specialty, and ask for local context. Owner: sales leadership. Unlocks: whether to open a deeper review of the territory.
- Great Lakes, week of 2026-07-06: re-run when the corrected feed lands, and disclose the restated week. Owner: the data vendor and commercial analytics. Unlocks: whether the restated week changes any figure already reported.
- Metacora: track the basket shares each week. Owner: marketing and sales. Unlocks: whether to adjust the response to Metacora.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the four weeks before (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-29). Source: the brief's default rule, the four weeks before the period.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Holiday weeks are left out. Source: the feed gate.
- Not observed: Great Lakes is projected or estimated, not counted. Source: panel coverage and each territory's recent share of national.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Panel coverage: the share of a territory's expected prescription records that arrived in a given week.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Estimated territory: a territory whose coverage is too low to project, or whose count failed its checks, filled from its own recent share of national and labelled as estimated, an assumption.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

with wk as (select unnest([DATE '2026-07-06']) as week_start), cut as (select p.week_start, p.territory_id, p.basis, p.projected_trx from reporting.v_rx_projection p join wk using (week_start) where p.product_id = 'BXA'), clean as (select wk.week_start as target, c.week_start from wk join raw.calendar c on c.week_start < wk.week_start where c.holiday_flag = 0 and c.plan_year_reset = 0 and not exists (select 1 from reporting.v_feed_health h where h.week_start = c.week_start and h.health_status <> 'PASS') qualify row_number() over (partition by wk.week_start order by c.week_start desc) <= 4), share as (select cl.target, r.territory_id, sum(r.trx) / sum(sum(r.trx)) over (partition by cl.target) as s from clean cl join reporting.v_reportable_rx r on r.week_start = cl.week_start and r.product_id = 'BXA' group by 1, 2), nat as (select c.week_start, sum(c.projected_trx) filter (where c.basis <> 'estimated') / (1 - coalesce(sum(s.s) filter (where c.basis = 'estimated'), 0)) as national from cut c left join share s on s.target = c.week_start and s.territory_id = c.territory_id group by 1 having count(*) filter (where c.basis <> 'estimated') > 0) select avg(national) from nat

with cuts as (
            select coalesce(plan_id, 'Unclassified') as cut,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2026-07-06')), 0) / 1.0 as recent,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2026-06-08',DATE '2026-06-15',DATE '2026-06-22',DATE '2026-06-29')), 0) / 4.0 as baseline
            from reporting.v_reportable_rx
            where product_id = 'BXA' and territory_id = 'PACIFIC'
                and week_start in (DATE '2026-06-08',DATE '2026-06-15',DATE '2026-06-22',DATE '2026-06-29',DATE '2026-07-06')
            group by 1

                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2025-07-07',DATE '2025-07-14',DATE '2025-07-21',DATE '2025-07-28')), 0) / 4.0 as baseline

P2-Q2.question: Weeks of 2025-08-04 to 2025-10-27, Mid-Atlantic: What explanations were considered, and why were the others ruled out?

P2-Q3.answer:
Brief for weeks 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx averaged 4,604 a week from 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 9.7% against the four weeks before (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-24).
BXA held 31.4% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the Southeast change (up 31.9%); its confidence, Low, is the lowest of this brief's stories.
Before Metacora launched, BXA held 35.4% of the four-brand basket.
## The numbers
Scope: weeks 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28, compared with the four weeks before (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-24).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,604 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 9.7% against the comparison weeks.
Against the comparison weeks, South Central fell most (down 4.4%) and Southeast rose most (up 31.9%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28: projected national and South Central. Hollow points are projected or estimated, an assumption (weeks of 2026-07-06). No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,285 in the week of 2026-07-06 to 4,808 in the week of 2026-09-28.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 692 BXA TRx a week; up 13.8% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 719 BXA TRx a week; up 4.7% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 393 BXA TRx a week; up 12.7% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 411 BXA TRx a week; up 8.4% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 420 BXA TRx a week; up 9.4% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 751 BXA TRx a week; up 7.1% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 575 BXA TRx a week; down 4.4% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 644 BXA TRx a week; up 31.9% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Southeast. BXA TRx averaged 644 a week against 488 before (up 31.9%), while the other territories were up 6.8%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Southeast cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the Southeast plans in the tested months.
- Promotion: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. Aggregated calls averaged 43 a week against 42 in the reference weeks.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.99.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 13.6% of the basket here against 13.5% elsewhere.
Confidence: Low. Unresolved, investigate next. No driver is named.
Chart: Southeast BXA TRx a week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28, against the band of its baseline weeks (437 to 546). No driver was supported, so only TRx is shown.
In the week of 2026-09-28, Southeast had 799 BXA TRx, above its baseline band.
Cuts of the change by plan, weekly TRx. Total: up 156 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D plan one: up 40 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan one: up 33 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D plan two: up 22 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan two: up 21 TRx a week.
- Medicaid plan one: up 16 TRx a week.
Cuts of the change by specialty, weekly TRx. Total: up 156 TRx a week.
- Primary care: up 70 TRx a week.
- Internal medicine: up 35 TRx a week.
- Cardiology: up 31 TRx a week.
- Endocrinology: up 21 TRx a week.
Cuts of the change by channel, weekly TRx. Total: up 156 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D: up 62 TRx a week.
- Commercial: up 53 TRx a week.
- Medicaid: up 30 TRx a week.
- Cash: up 11 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
Story two: South Central. BXA TRx averaged 575 a week against 601 before (down 4.4%), while the other territories were up 12.0%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every South Central cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the South Central plans in the tested months.
- Promotion: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. Aggregated calls averaged 46 a week against 47 in the reference weeks.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 13.3% of the basket here against 13.6% elsewhere.
Confidence: Low. Unresolved, investigate next. No driver is named.
Chart: South Central BXA TRx a week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28, against the band of its baseline weeks (578 to 627). No driver was supported, so only TRx is shown.
In the week of 2026-09-28, South Central had 583 BXA TRx, inside its baseline band.
Cuts of the change by plan, weekly TRx. Total: down 27 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan one: down 12 TRx a week.
- Medicaid plan one: down 12 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D plan one: down 7 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan two: down 6 TRx a week.
- Medicaid plan two: up 6 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
Cuts of the change by specialty, weekly TRx. Total: down 27 TRx a week.
- Primary care: down 18 TRx a week.
- Cardiology: down 4 TRx a week.
- Endocrinology: down 3 TRx a week.
- Internal medicine: down 2 TRx a week.
Cuts of the change by channel, weekly TRx. Total: down 27 TRx a week.
- Commercial: down 18 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D: down 8 TRx a week.
- Medicaid: down 6 TRx a week.
- Cash: up 6 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
Story three: competitor Metacora (launched 2026-03-02). This is a continuing story, week 30 since launch, still growing. Metacora held 15.2% of the four-brand basket and BXA held 31.4%, against 35.4% for BXA in the four weeks before launch. Confidence: Medium. The share loss is measured; its effect on volume is not separated from other drivers.
Chart: Shares of the four-brand basket, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28, every reportable territory.
Metacora held 15.2% of the basket in the week of 2026-09-28.
Considered and dropped: 6 territories moved within their normal range.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 0 territory-weeks are withheld across these weeks. No cut is withheld.
Calendar weeks in this period are left out of the stories below, because lower volume there is expected.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28. Crossed cells are estimated, an assumption.
1 territory-week in this window is not an observed count.
Feed for South Central in these weeks: 640 rows received against 640 expected; lowest panel coverage 1.000.
## Next checks
- Southeast: split by plan and specialty, and ask for local context. Owner: sales leadership. Unlocks: whether to open a deeper review of the territory.
- South Central: split by plan and specialty, and ask for local context. Owner: sales leadership. Unlocks: whether to open a deeper review of the territory.
- Metacora: track the basket shares each week. Owner: marketing and sales. Unlocks: whether to adjust the response to Metacora.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the four weeks before (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-24). Source: the brief's default rule, the four weeks before the period.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Calendar weeks are left out of the stories. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Panel coverage: the share of a territory's expected prescription records that arrived in a given week.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

with cuts as (
            select coalesce(plan_id, 'Unclassified') as cut,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2026-08-31',DATE '2026-09-14',DATE '2026-09-21',DATE '2026-09-28')), 0) / 4.0 as recent,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2026-08-03',DATE '2026-08-10',DATE '2026-08-17',DATE '2026-08-24')), 0) / 4.0 as baseline
            from reporting.v_reportable_rx
            where product_id = 'BXA' and territory_id = 'SOUTHEAST'
                and week_start in (DATE '2026-08-03',DATE '2026-08-10',DATE '2026-08-17',DATE '2026-08-24',DATE '2026-08-31',DATE '2026-09-14',DATE '2026-09-21',DATE '2026-09-28')
            group by 1
        ), ordered as (
            select *, recent - baseline as delta,
                row_number() over (order by abs(recent - baseline) desc, cut) as rank
            from cuts
        ), running as (
            select *, round(sum(delta) over (order by rank), 2) as cumulative
            from ordered
        ), contributions as (
            select *, cumulative - lag(cumulative, 1, 0) over (order by rank) as contribution
            from running
        )
    select abs(cumulative) from running order by rank desc limit 1

## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx is 4,590 for the week of 2026-04-27.

Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the four weeks before (2026-03-30 to 2026-04-20). Source: the brief's default rule, the four weeks before the period.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Holiday weeks are left out. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

P3-Q1.question: Week of 2026-04-27: What changed this week that I need to know about?

P3-Q4.answer:
Brief for week of 2026-09-28. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx is 4,808 for the week of 2026-09-28.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 8.4% against the four weeks before (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-21).
BXA held 32.1% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the New England change (up 26.8%); its confidence, Low, is the lowest of this brief's stories.
Before Metacora launched, BXA held 35.4% of the four-brand basket.
## The numbers
Scope: week of 2026-09-28, compared with the four weeks before (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-21).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,808 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 8.4% against the comparison weeks.
Week over week, BXA TRx is 4,808 against 4,701 the week before (up 2.3%).
Against the comparison weeks, Great Lakes fell most (down 8.3%) and Southeast rose most (up 38.7%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28: projected national. Hollow points are projected or estimated, an assumption (weeks of 2026-07-06). No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 4,285 in the week of 2026-07-06 to 4,808 in the week of 2026-09-28.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 626 BXA TRx a week; down 14.4% on the week before; down 8.3% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 706 BXA TRx a week; down 8.1% on the week before; up 0.5% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 407 BXA TRx a week; down 2.6% on the week before; up 9.2% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 477 BXA TRx a week; up 28.9% on the week before; up 26.8% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 389 BXA TRx a week; down 13.0% on the week before; down 7.8% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 821 BXA TRx a week; up 2.5% on the week before; up 10.8% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 583 BXA TRx a week; up 5.8% on the week before; up 3.6% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 799 BXA TRx a week; up 29.9% on the week before; up 38.7% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Southeast. BXA TRx averaged 799 a week against 576 before (up 38.7%), while the other territories were up 3.9%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Southeast cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the Southeast plans in the tested months.
- Promotion: supported as an association, one-week lag. Aggregated calls averaged 53 a week against 40 in the reference weeks (31.2% higher).
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.99.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 15.1% of the basket here against 14.2% elsewhere.
Confidence: Medium. Candidate drivers: promotion.
Chart: Southeast BXA TRx a week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28, against the band of its baseline weeks (451 to 710). Second panel: Aggregated rep calls a week, the driver the checks support.
In the week of 2026-09-28, Southeast had 799 BXA TRx, above its baseline band.
Cuts of the change by plan, weekly TRx. Total: up 223 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D plan one: up 92 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan one: up 57 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan two: up 27 TRx a week.
- Cash plan one: up 17 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).

Cuts of the change by specialty, weekly TRx. Total: up 223 TRx a week.
- Primary care: up 95 TRx a week.
- Cardiology: up 62 TRx a week.
- Internal medicine: up 59 TRx a week.
- Endocrinology: up 7 TRx a week.
Cuts of the change by channel, weekly TRx. Total: up 223 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D: up 109 TRx a week.
- Commercial: up 84 TRx a week.
- Medicaid: up 17 TRx a week.
- Cash: up 13 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
Story two: New England. BXA TRx averaged 477 a week against 376 before (up 26.8%), while the other territories were up 6.7%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every New England cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: ruled out. No BXA access change in the New England plans in the tested months.
- Promotion: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. Aggregated calls averaged 28 a week against 30 in the reference weeks.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out as a local cause. Before the change Metacora held 14.5% of the basket here against 14.3% elsewhere.
Confidence: Low. Unresolved, investigate next. No driver is named.
Chart: New England BXA TRx a week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28, against the band of its baseline weeks (337 to 434). No driver was supported, so only TRx is shown.
In the week of 2026-09-28, New England had 477 BXA TRx, above its baseline band.
Cuts of the change by plan, weekly TRx. Total: up 101 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D plan one: up 36 TRx a week.
- Commercial plan one: up 31 TRx a week.
- Medicaid plan one: up 19 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
- Medicare Part D plan two: up 12 TRx a week.
- Cash plan two: down 5 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
Cuts of the change by specialty, weekly TRx. Total: up 101 TRx a week.
- Cardiology: up 41 TRx a week.
- Endocrinology: up 28 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
- Primary care: up 27 TRx a week.
- Internal medicine: up 5 TRx a week.
Cuts of the change by channel, weekly TRx. Total: up 101 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D: up 48 TRx a week.
- Commercial: up 33 TRx a week.
- Medicaid: up 22 TRx a week.
- Cash: down 2 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
Story three: competitor Metacora (launched 2026-03-02). This is a continuing story, week 30 since launch, still growing. Metacora held 15.2% of the four-brand basket and BXA held 32.1%, against 35.4% for BXA in the four weeks before launch. Confidence: Medium. The share loss is measured; its effect on volume is not separated from other drivers.
Chart: Shares of the four-brand basket, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28, every reportable territory.
Metacora held 15.2% of the basket in the week of 2026-09-28.
Considered and dropped: 6 territories moved within their normal range.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 8 of 8 territories pass the feed gate for 2026-09-28. No cut is withheld.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-28. Crossed cells are estimated, an assumption.
1 territory-week in this window is not an observed count.
## Next checks
- Southeast: confirm the promotion finding. Owner: sales leadership and marketing. Unlocks: whether to change call plans or campaign timing in the territory.
- New England: split by plan and specialty, and ask for local context. Owner: sales leadership. Unlocks: whether to open a deeper review of the territory.
- Metacora: track the basket shares each week. Owner: marketing and sales. Unlocks: whether to adjust the response to Metacora.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the four weeks before (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-21). Source: the brief's default rule, the four weeks before the period.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Holiday weeks are left out. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag.
- Driver timing: Southeast: promotion, one-week lag. Source: recorded activity and reportable TRx.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

with cuts as (
            select coalesce(plan_id, 'Unclassified') as cut,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2026-09-28')), 0) / 1.0 as recent,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2026-08-31',DATE '2026-09-07',DATE '2026-09-14',DATE '2026-09-21')), 0) / 4.0 as baseline
            from reporting.v_reportable_rx
            where product_id = 'BXA' and territory_id = 'SOUTHEAST'
                and week_start in (DATE '2026-08-31',DATE '2026-09-07',DATE '2026-09-14',DATE '2026-09-21',DATE '2026-09-28')
            group by 1
        ), ordered as (
            select *, recent - baseline as delta,
                row_number() over (order by abs(recent - baseline) desc, cut) as rank
            from cuts
        ), running as (
            select *, round(sum(delta) over (order by rank), 2) as cumulative
            from ordered
        ), contributions as (
            select *, cumulative - lag(cumulative, 1, 0) over (order by rank) as contribution
            from running
        )
    select abs(cumulative) from running order by rank desc limit 1

P3-Q4.question: Week of 2026-09-28: Is this new or the same issue as last week, and is it getting better or worse?

P4-Q4.answer:
Brief for weeks 2025-11-03 to 2025-12-15. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx averaged 5,366 a week from 2025-11-03 to 2025-12-15.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 3.0% against the four weeks before (2025-10-06 to 2025-10-27).
BXA held 35.8% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the Mid-Atlantic change (up 4.6%); its confidence, High, is the lowest of this brief's stories.
## The numbers
Scope: weeks 2025-11-03 to 2025-12-15, compared with the four weeks before (2025-10-06 to 2025-10-27).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 5,366 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 3.0% against the comparison weeks.
Against the comparison weeks, Pacific fell most (down 5.0%) and Great Lakes rose most (up 9.7%).
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2025-09-22 to 2025-12-15: projected national and Mid-Atlantic. No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 5,044 in the week of 2025-09-22 to 5,370 in the week of 2025-12-15.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 791 BXA TRx a week; up 9.7% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 815 BXA TRx a week; up 4.6% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 387 BXA TRx a week; down 2.2% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 494 BXA TRx a week; up 4.9% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 493 BXA TRx a week; up 5.7% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 857 BXA TRx a week; down 5.0% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 733 BXA TRx a week; up 6.2% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 795 BXA TRx a week; up 1.5% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
Story one: Mid-Atlantic. BXA TRx averaged 815 a week against 779 before (up 4.6%), while the other territories were up 2.7%.
Checked, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Mid-Atlantic cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: supported. The Medicare Part D plan one (26.0% of the territory's covered lives) removed restrictions effective 2025-11-01. BXA volume on that plan rose 11.9%. The monthly source cannot distinguish a weekly lag.
- Promotion: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. Aggregated calls averaged 53 a week against 50 in the reference weeks.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out. Metacora did not launch until 2026-03-02.
Confidence: High. Leading driver: access.
Chart: Mid-Atlantic BXA TRx a week, 2025-09-22 to 2025-12-15, against the band of its baseline weeks (708 to 865). Second panel: BXA TRx on the plan whose access changed, the driver the checks support.
In the week of 2025-12-15, Mid-Atlantic had 785 BXA TRx, inside its baseline band.
Cuts of the change by plan, weekly TRx. Total: up 36 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D plan one: up 24 TRx a week.
- Cash plan two: up 9 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).
- Commercial plan two: up 6 TRx a week.
- Cash plan one: down 6 TRx a week (small cell: noisy).

Cuts of the change by specialty, weekly TRx. Total: up 36 TRx a week.
- Internal medicine: up 42 TRx a week.
- Cardiology: down 14 TRx a week.
- Primary care: up 7 TRx a week.
- Endocrinology: up 1 TRx a week.
Cuts of the change by channel, weekly TRx. Total: up 36 TRx a week.
- Medicare Part D: up 29 TRx a week.
- Commercial: up 4 TRx a week.
- Cash: up 3 TRx a week.
- Medicaid: flat 0 TRx a week.
Medicare Part D plan one in Mid-Atlantic: BXA TRx averaged 222 a week on the comparison weeks against 198 before (up 11.9%).
Confidence: High. Leading driver: access.
Checked for this plan, in this order:
- Data artifact: ruled out. Every Mid-Atlantic cut in these weeks passes the feed gate.
- Access: supported. The Medicare Part D plan one (26.0% of the territory's covered lives) removed restrictions effective 2025-11-01. BXA volume on that plan rose 11.9%. The monthly source cannot distinguish a weekly lag.
- Promotion: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. Aggregated calls averaged 53 a week against 50 in the reference weeks.
- Supply: ruled out. No tested lag lines up with TRx. BXA inventory fill averaged 0.98.
- Competitor launch: ruled out. Metacora did not launch until 2026-03-02.
Data, promotion, supply and competitor have no plan-level test, so they carry the Mid-Atlantic verdicts.
No detected coverage lapse or return overlaps the requested weeks.
Considered and dropped: 7 territories moved within their normal range.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 0 territory-weeks are withheld across these weeks. No cut is withheld.
Calendar weeks in this period are left out of the stories below, because lower volume there is expected.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2025-09-22 to 2025-12-15. Every cell is an observed count.
Every territory-week in this window is an observed count.
Feed for Mid-Atlantic in these weeks: 896 rows received against 896 expected; lowest panel coverage 1.000.
## Next checks
- Mid-Atlantic: confirm the access finding. Owner: market access. Unlocks: whether the plan's coverage change needs a pull-through response.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the four weeks before (2025-10-06 to 2025-10-27). Source: the brief's default rule, the four weeks before the period.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Calendar weeks are left out of the stories. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Panel coverage: the share of a territory's expected prescription records that arrived in a given week.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.

with cuts as (
            select coalesce(plan_id, 'Unclassified') as cut,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2025-11-03',DATE '2025-11-10',DATE '2025-11-17',DATE '2025-12-01',DATE '2025-12-08',DATE '2025-12-15')), 0) / 6.0 as recent,
                coalesce(sum(trx) filter (where week_start in (DATE '2025-10-06',DATE '2025-10-13',DATE '2025-10-20',DATE '2025-10-27')), 0) / 4.0 as baseline
            from reporting.v_reportable_rx
            where product_id = 'BXA' and territory_id = 'MID_ATLANTIC'
                and week_start in (DATE '2025-10-06',DATE '2025-10-13',DATE '2025-10-20',DATE '2025-10-27',DATE '2025-11-03',DATE '2025-11-10',DATE '2025-11-17',DATE '2025-12-01',DATE '2025-12-08',DATE '2025-12-15')
            group by 1
        ), ordered as (
            select *, recent - baseline as delta,
                row_number() over (order by abs(recent - baseline) desc, cut) as rank
            from cuts
        ), running as (
            select *, round(sum(delta) over (order by rank), 2) as cumulative
            from ordered
        ), contributions as (
            select *, cumulative - lag(cumulative, 1, 0) over (order by rank) as contribution
            from running
        )
    select abs(cumulative) from running order by rank desc limit 1

WIN-1.answer:
Brief for weeks 2025-12-22 to 2025-12-29. Product: BXA.
## Bottom line
Projected national BXA TRx averaged 4,249 a week from 2025-12-22 to 2025-12-29.
Like for like on 8 of 8 territories, BXA TRx is up 9.8% against the same weeks last year (2024-12-23, 2024-12-30).
BXA held 37.0% of the four-brand market basket.
Least sure: the like-for-like change, the only change this brief states.
## The numbers
Scope: weeks 2025-12-22 to 2025-12-29, compared with the same weeks last year (2024-12-23, 2024-12-30).
Like for like, BXA TRx averaged 4,249 a week across 8 of 8 territories, up 9.8% against the comparison weeks.
Against the comparison weeks, South Central fell most (down 2.7%) and New England rose most (up 20.3%).
Calendar effect: the week of 2025-12-22 is christmas week with 4 business days, so a lower volume is expected.
Calendar effect: the week of 2025-12-29 is new year week with 4 business days, so a lower volume is expected.
Chart: BXA TRx a week, 2025-10-06 to 2025-12-29: projected national. No forecast is drawn.
Projected national moved from 5,213 in the week of 2025-10-06 to 4,188 in the week of 2025-12-29.
By territory, all observed.
Great Lakes: 631 BXA TRx a week; up 15.3% on the comparison weeks.
Mid-Atlantic: 674 BXA TRx a week; up 17.6% on the comparison weeks.
Mountain: 362 BXA TRx a week; up 9.2% on the comparison weeks.
New England: 373 BXA TRx a week; up 20.3% on the comparison weeks.
Northwest: 353 BXA TRx a week; down 1.7% on the comparison weeks.
Pacific: 666 BXA TRx a week; up 6.7% on the comparison weeks.
South Central: 559 BXA TRx a week; down 2.7% on the comparison weeks.
Southeast: 632 BXA TRx a week; up 14.3% on the comparison weeks.
## What changed and why
No story is opened for a calendar week. Expect a rebound in the next regular week.
## What the data can't tell us
Data health: 0 territory-weeks are withheld across these weeks. No cut is withheld.
Chart: Feed coverage by territory and week, 2025-10-06 to 2025-12-29. Every cell is an observed count.
Every territory-week in this window is an observed count.
## Next checks
No check is open.
## Appendix
Data version 47bcfd650564. Product: BXA (Cardiovela), synthetic data.
Assumptions:
- Comparison weeks: the same weeks last year (2024-12-23, 2024-12-30). Source: analyst's choice.
- Like for like: changes use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. Withheld cuts are left out of every change and story, and never read as zero demand. Holiday weeks are left out. Source: the feed gate.
- Drivers: the checks evaluate the same week and delays of one and two weeks. A supported timing requires activity to move with reportable TRx. Monthly access data cannot identify a weekly lag.
Method: like-for-like figures use only territories whose feed passed the gate in every week compared. The projected national divides each territory's observed TRx by its panel coverage, and estimates a territory that cannot be read from its recent share of national. Changes, stories and drivers use like-for-like cuts only.
Glossary:
- Like for like: a comparison that uses only territories whose feed passed its checks in every week compared.
- Projected national: national TRx built territory by territory, each territory's observed TRx divided by its panel coverage, summed.
- Withheld cut: a territory or week whose data failed its checks, so no story or driver is given for it.
